"""Time the parts of one W2-123 retry case: the fixture project, the lexical refresh, the semantic refresh."""
import cProfile
import os
import pstats
import sys
import tempfile
import time
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path("/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-123-tests/tests/acceptance/W2-123")
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE))
import test_w2_123_retry as T  # noqa: E402

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
    place = T.Place(Path(tmp) / "place")
    for key, value in place.settings().items():
        os.environ[key] = value
    started = time.monotonic()
    project = T.make_project(Path(tmp) / "project")
    print("make_project", round(time.monotonic() - started, 2))
    runner = place.serve()
    from gov.retrieval import lexical, semantic
    started = time.monotonic()
    profile = cProfile.Profile()
    profile.enable()
    report = semantic.refresh(project)
    profile.disable()
    print("refresh", round(time.monotonic() - started, 2), report, len(runner.batches))
    pstats.Stats(profile).sort_stats("cumulative").print_stats(18)
    place.close()
